description: Write a failing test, see it fail, implement, verify.

nodes.name: write-test
nodes.prompt: Add a test that reproduces the claimed issue and fails until it is fixed. Commit only the test, then file a ready report. If you are here again, the verification command passed, so the test does not fail yet: make it reproduce the issue.

nodes.name: implement
nodes.prompt: The new test fails as intended; its output is attached. Implement the fix in this worktree and commit it without weakening the test, then file a ready report, or a blocked report naming what stops you.

nodes.name: done
nodes.message: The new test failed first and the verification command passes.
